title: CWR
description: CWR is a competitive Minecraft server with Duels, Lifesteal, Bedwars, and an active player community.
body:
CWR MC Network is a growing Sri Lankan Minecraft network featuring Lifesteal, Bedwars, Duels, and more with an active community and exciting gameplay across multiple modes. Whether you enjoy intense PvP battles or survival adventures, CWR offers something for every type of player.

Our most popular gamemodes include Lifesteal SMP, where defeating players lets you steal their hearts and dominate the world, Bedwars where teams fight to protect their bed while destroying others, and Duels where players can practice PvP skills in fast-paced competitive matches.

The server also offers Survival SMP, Skyblock, KitPvP, and Minigames, giving players many ways to play and enjoy Minecraft with friends. With frequent updates, events, and an active player base, there is always something happening on CWR MC.

Java & Bedrock Supported  
Java IP: mc.cwresports.lk  
Bedrock IP: mc.cwresports.lk:19132
